stem: Students conduct experiments to investigate friction. Which experiment will best test the effect of friction on objects?

options.label: F
options.text: Drop two balls from the same height at the same time

options.label: G
options.text: Roll two marbles on the carpet from the same starting point at the same time and with the same amount of force

options.label: H
options.text: Roll three marbles across three different surfaces from the same starting point at the same time and with the same amount of force

options.label: J
options.text: Release two balls from the top of a ramp at the same time
